cases.where: application_description='Zoning' AND application_date IS NOT NULL

source.name: City of Orlando Planning
source.currentRecordsNote: Zoning cases come from the city's Planning Applications dataset, scoped to the Zoning application type (about 450 cases since 2002; the same table also holds annexations, variances and master plans). Existing and proposed zoning appear only inside each case's comments, not as columns, and the status is Open or Closed without saying approved or denied. About half the case addresses (221 of 407) carry two or three spaces after the house number; the search matches that gap as a run of one to four spaces, or the spacing as typed, and nothing else, so a full address finds them as well as a street name alone does.
